changeList.full_content:
env:
  NO_COLOR: 1

definitions:
  plugins:
    - &docker-node
      https://bitbucket.org/smart_eco-platform/docker-buildkite-plugin#v1:
        image: 'node:20'
        shell: ['/bin/bash', '-e', '-u', '-c']
    - &cache-node_modules
      cache#v1.3.0:
        manifest: pnpm-lock.yaml
        path: node_modules
        restore: pipeline
        save: file
    - &common_plugins [*docker-node, *cache-node_modules]

  steps:
    - &deploy
      plugins: *common_plugins
      commands:
        - |
          if [[ "$$TARGET" != "stage" && "$$TARGET" != "prod" ]]; then
            echo "ℹ️  Skipping permission check for $$TARGET"
          else
            if [[ ! ":$$BUILDKITE_UNBLOCKER_TEAMS:" =~ ":website-release:" ]]; then
              echo "❌ ACCESS DENIED: you don't have permission to deploy to $$TARGET"
              exit 1
            fi
          fi
          echo "🚀 Proceeding to deployment..."
        - npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
        - npx pnpm run deploy --stage $$TARGET

    - &deploy_firewall_optional
      plugins: *common_plugins
      commands:
        - |
          VAL="$$(buildkite-agent meta-data get "$$FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY" || echo "false")"
          if [[ -z "$$VAL" ]]; then VAL="false"; fi
          echo "$$FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY=$$VAL"

          if [[ "$$VAL" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "🚫 Skipping firewall deployment"
            exit 0
          fi
          npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          npx sst deploy --stage $$TARGET --region us-east-1

    - &release_optional
      plugins: *common_plugins
      commands:
        - |
          VAL="$(buildkite-agent meta-data get "$$RELEASE_PROMPT_KEY" || echo "false")"
          if [[ -z "$$VAL" ]]; then VAL="false"; fi
          echo "$$RELEASE_PROMPT_KEY=$VAL"
          if [[ "$VAL" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "ℹ️  Skipping release"
            exit 0
          fi

          git remote update &&
          git fetch &&
          git fetch --tags &&
          git checkout "$BUILDKITE_BRANCH" &&
          git reset --hard "$BUILDKITE_COMMIT" &&
          npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile &&
          npx pnpm run docs:build

          if [[ "$$RELEASE_KIND" == "pre" ]]; then
            BRANCH=$(echo "$BUILDKITE_BRANCH" | tr '/' '-' | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]' | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9-]//g')
            COMMIT_ID=$(echo "$BUILDKITE_COMMIT" | cut -c1-4)
            npx release-it --preRelease "$BRANCH-$COMMIT_ID" --ci
          else
            npx release-it --ci
          fi
          git push origin "HEAD:$BUILDKITE_BRANCH" --tags
          npm publish --tag "$$NPM_TAG"

steps:
  - label: ':npm: dependencies'
    key: 'deps'
    plugins: *common_plugins
    commands:
      - npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile

  - label: ':npm: CI Checks'
    key: 'checks'
    depends_on: 'deps'
    plugins: *common_plugins
    commands:
      - npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
      - npx pnpm run generate-sst-types --stage dev
      - npx pnpm run typecheck
      - npx pnpm run lint

  - wait: ~

  - group: ':package: Pre-release'
    if: build.branch =~ /^feature\//
    steps:
      - block: ':rocket: Pre-release declarations'
        key: 'pre-release-declarations'
        depends_on: 'checks'
        prompt: 'Do you want to run pre-release declarations?'
        fields:
          - select: 'Run pre-release declarations?'
            key: 'run_pre_release_declarations'
            default: 'false'
            options:
              - label: 'Yes'
                value: 'true'
              - label: 'No'
                value: 'false'

      - label: 'pre-release declarations'
        depends_on: 'pre-release-declarations'
        env:
          RELEASE_PROMPT_KEY: run_pre_release_declarations
          RELEASE_KIND: pre
          NPM_TAG: rc
        <<: *release_optional

  - group: ':package: Deploy Dev'
    if: build.branch == "develop"
    steps:
      - block: ':rocket: Publish release version'
        label: 'Publish release versi

analysis.summary: Three high severity functional bugs identified: stage deployment branch matcher regression breaks release branches, firewall deployment missing authorization checks, and develop branch NPM publishing changed to latest tag.

bugs.title: Stage deployment branch matcher regression
bugs.description: Changed stage deployment condition from regex matching release/* branches to exact match 'release', breaking standard release branch naming like release/v1.0.0
bugs.risk: Prevents deployment to stage environment for any release branch with version suffixes, blocking all standard release workflows
bugs.codeSnippet:
-    if: build.branch =~ /^release\\// || build.branch =~ /^hotfix\\//
+    if: build.branch == 'release' || build.branch =~ /^hotfix\\//

bugs.title: Firewall deployment missing permission checks
bugs.description: The new deploy_firewall_optional anchor removed team permission checks for stage/prod deployments that existed in the old deploy_us_east_1 anchor
bugs.risk: Allows unauthorized users without website-release team membership to deploy firewall changes to production and stage environments
bugs.codeSnippet:
- &deploy_firewall_optional
      plugins: *common_plugins
      commands:
        - |
          VAL="$(buildkite-agent meta-data get "$FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY" || echo "false")"
          if [[ -z "$VAL" ]]; then VAL="false"; fi
          echo "$FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY=$VAL"

          if [[ "$VAL" != "true" ]]; then
            echo "🚫 Skipping firewall deployment"
            exit 0
          fi
          npx pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
          npx sst deploy --stage $TARGET --region us-east-1

bugs.title: Develop branch publishes to NPM latest tag
bugs.description: Changed NPM publish tag from 'stage' to 'latest' for develop branch releases, causing development builds to be published as the latest stable version
bugs.risk: Users installing the package will receive unstable development builds instead of the latest stable release, breaking downstream dependencies
bugs.codeSnippet:
- label: 'Publish release version'
        depends_on: 'publish-release'
        env:
          RELEASE_PROMPT_KEY: PUBLISH_RELEASE_STAGE
          RELEASE_KIND: release
          NPM_TAG: latest
        <<: *release_optional

notBugs.reason: While 'deplop-firewall-dev' is misspelled, it is used consistently in both the block step definition and the FIREWALL_PROMPT_KEY reference, so it functions correctly
Changing from build.branch != 'main' to build.branch =~ /^feature\\// appears to be an intentional restriction of pre-releases to feature branches only
